panels.title: Invocations by function and outcome, over time
panels.description: huntloop_modal_resume_invocations_total - every resume-processing/embedding call routed through huntloop.modal_resume_processing, split by function (process_resume_remote / embed_text_remote) and outcome (success / fallback_not_configured / fallback_lookup_failed / fallback_budget_exhausted / fallback_invocation_error). Pushed once per call, from POST /resumes/upload and PATCH /resumes/{id}/activate.

panels.title: Successful Modal calls vs. fallback-to-local (current)
panels.description: huntloop_modal_resume_invocations_total summed across the whole history, grouped into success vs. any fallback_* outcome - a snapshot of how often Modal is actually being used vs. falling back, not a rate.

panels.title: Budget-cap rejections, over time
panels.description: huntloop_modal_resume_invocations_total{outcome="fallback_budget_exhausted"} - calls that fell back to the local path specifically because this month's MODAL_MONTHLY_INVOCATION_BUDGET was already spent, as opposed to Modal not being configured or erroring.

panels.title: Monthly invocation budget used vs. cap
panels.description: huntloop_modal_invocation_budget_used / huntloop_modal_invocation_budget_cap - the modal_usage ledger's current-month invocations_used against MODAL_MONTHLY_INVOCATION_BUDGET (default 500), updated on every budget check (POST /resumes/upload, PATCH /resumes/{id}/activate). Resets to 0 at the start of each calendar month.
